A screenshot showing the file '/home/ga/shortcuts_reference.txt' exists in the file system.

task_completion.description: The text file contains the correct keys and descriptions for Mute, Camera, and Filmstrip in the specified format.

integrity.description: The agent accessed the shortcuts via the Jitsi GUI rather than just writing the file from memory.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots must show the agent clicking the 'More actions' (three dots) menu and selecting 'View keyboard shortcuts'.

integrity.description: The saved image 'shortcuts_evidence.png' is an actual capture of the application, not a placeholder.
integrity.visual_evidence: The content of 'shortcuts_evidence.png' matches the visual style of the Jitsi version being used in the trajectory.

integrity.description: The agent did not create the text file before actually viewing the shortcuts overlay.
integrity.visual_evidence: The timeline of screenshots should show the shortcuts overlay being opened BEFORE the text file is finalized.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The correct Jitsi shortcuts are: M for Mute/Unmute Microphone, V for Start/Stop Camera, and F for Show/Hide Filmstrip (video thumbnails). The agent must join the room 'TrainingSession' and use the name 'Training Lead'.
